2. The facts leading to the disposal of the instant rule is that the above named opposite party No.1 as plaintiff on 09.03.2003 instituted Title Suit No.61 of 2003 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Kushtia Sadar, Kushtia impleading the above petitioners and opposite parties Nos. 2-25 as defendants on the averments that she purchased .0237 acres of land by registered kabala dated 20.08.1989 from Waliur Rahman and also purchased .0240 acres by another kabala from Golam Mohiuddin, and thus she totally purchased 0.0477 acres out of .16 acres of land corresponding to C.S. Khatian No. 716, S.A. Khatian No. 1092, Rs. Khatian No. 610. C.S. Plot No. 404, R.S. Plot No. 4504/4508/4809 J.L. No. previous 33 at present 23 of Mouza Mojampur, District Kushtia and has been enjoying the same. Defendants have been enjoying the land also in ejmali. There are trees and semi pucca house in the suit land. The defendants refused to partition the suit land by metes and bounds and hence the suit for partition claiming her Saham of 0.0477 acres out of .16 acres as detailed to the schedule of the plaint. 

 3. The above petitioners as defendants No. 1-5 have been contesting the suit by filing a set of written statement denying all material averments of the plaint contending that the predecessors of these defendants had been the owner and possessors total .16 acres of S.A. Khatian No. 1092 corresponding to Plot No. 404 by mutual partition and SA and R.S. record has been prepared in their name correctly. In the same way the plaintiff predecessors got some land from other portion which they sold out earlier. The vendor of the plaintiff Md. Waliur Rahman lost in Title Suit No. 288 of 1984 and Title Suit No. 27 of 1988 and his appeal being Title Appeal No. 30 of 1986 was also dismissed and as such the plaintiff has accrued no title by way of purchase from Waliur Rahman. The plaintiff and her husband being aware of all these facts filed the instant suit on false averments in order to disturb the defendants long possession of 81/82 years, moreover, the instant suit for partition without declaration of the title and recovery of possession is not maintainable in the present form, and as such the suit would liable to be dismissed with cost. 

 4. During the pendency of the said Title Suit No. 61 of 2003 the above petitioners Nos. 1-4 as plaintiffs on 03.01.2008 instituted Title Suit No. 12 of 2008 before the self same court impleading the above petitioner No.5 as defendant No.1 and opposite party No. 1 as defendant No.2 along with same other defendants on the averments that the mother of the plaintiffs and defendant No. 1 namely Suratunnessa got 1.0813 acres of land by different deeds dated 02.06.1941, 22.09.1964, 23.08.1968, 15.03.1960, 27.01.1973, 20.12.1962, 19.12.1962, 20.09.1968 and 11.04.1945 and from that she gifted 0.2840 acres vide gift deeds dated 01.02.1978 and 14.03.1979 to his sons plaintiffs No. 1-4 and .06 acres to her grandson Masudur Rahman on 30.01.1984 and during her title over remaining (1.0813-03440) acres .7373 acres died leaving behind his four sons, the plaintiffs Nos. 1-4 and one daughter, defendant No.1 and wherefrom each sons got .1638 acres and daughter defendant No. 1 got .0819 acres, and thus the plaintiffs got .2840 acres by way of gift from their mother and .6542 acres by way of inheritance i.e. totally .9364 acres, the plaintiffs have homestead, garden, pond and shops on the suit land and they have been possessing the same. Defendant No. 1 got .0064 acres as gift from her mother and .0819 acres by inheritance and thus she got .0883 acres totally that R.s. record has been prepared correctly and finally in the name of Suratunnessa, the predecessor of the plaintiff and defendant No. 1. The defendants have no title and possession over the suit land. The defendants refused to partition the suit land by metes and bounds lastly on 22.11.2007, hence the suit for partition corresponding to C.S. Khatian No. 716, C.s. Plot No. 404/375/376/, S.A. Khatian No. 1092, R.s. Khatian No. 610 and 1306, RS Plot No. 4504/4508/4509/4154/ 4258/ 4159, claiming Saham of .9364 acres out of 1.0334 acres as detailed to the schedule of the plaint. 

 6. The above opposite party No.1 as defendant No.2 has been contesting the suit by filing a set of written statement denying all material averments of the plaint further contending that Jaferanness and their predecessor Tasirunnessa were in equal share of .16 acres of C.S. Khatian No. 716 Plot No. 404. Taserunnessa died leaving behind his only son Samser Ali Mollah, who during his possession and enjoyment died leaving behind his 4 sons, Golam Mohiuddin, Sirajul Islam, Golam Jakaria, Younus Ali and two daughters Saleha and Sahedur and one wife Nazimunnessa. Jaferunnessa died leaving her only daughter Sarannessa Bibi and when S.A. record was prepared in his name including whole .16 acres in Khatian No. 1092 then Golam Mohiuddin and others filed Title Suit No. 250 of 1963 in the Court of the then Munsef Kushtia and got a decree, where upon the Sera Nessa Bibi filed Title Appeal No. 116 of 1964 in the Court of District Judge, Kushtia which was also dismissed and on Second Appeal before the High Court Division being Second Appeal No. 1267 of 1965 the judgment of the trial court was affirmed. The plaintiffs suppressing all those facts being plaintiffs the four brothers, their mother Sara Nessa, and their sister the defendant No.1 filed Partition Suit No. 678 of 1978 in the Court of Munsef, Kushtia against Mohiuddin and others and during contesting of the suit the plaintiffs got an ex-parte decree that challenging the said ex-parte decree Golam Mohiuddin and others filed Title Suit No. 279 of 1985 and got a decree where upon the plaintiffs filed Title Appeal No. 10 of 1979 which was dismissed. During the possession and enjoyment of the said land the Grandson of Tasirannessa, Golam Zakaria, and Yunus Ali sold their portion on 10.04.1988 to Waliur Rahman, who sold .0237 acres on 20.08.1989 to this defendant. Sirajul Islam also sold .0240 acres on 16.09.1990 to this defendant and in these way this defendant has been owning and possessing .0477 acres by way of purchase in ejmali and for which this defendant as plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 61 of 2003 in the selfsame court for partition claiming her Saham of .0177 acres. The plaintiffs by suppressing some fact filed the instant suit claiming mare land and whole land of plot No. 404, and as such the suit would be dismissed with cost.
